title: ever MONICA|Long Empire Waist Bridesmaid Dress with Short Flutter Sleeves
descriptionHtml:
This beautiful evening dress features a v neckline, empire waist, flutter sleeves, and subtle high low hemline.?This long empire waist evening dress?is a beautiful choice for bridesmaids and any formal events. It's long chiffon flowy skirt is very suitable for summer occasions.

New Tulle Version:Tulle Bridesmaid Dresses


New Sequin Version:Shimmery Evening Gowns


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor Length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
